verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say it supports unattended access with a permanent password, which is the core of pre-configured credentials that need no one at the host to accept. Coverage is limited, though: the documentation is a single brief mention, and Wayland unattended access and login-screen access exist only in a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu preview build. A community user confirms that Wayland unattended access was a gap until that fix. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how an admin pre-configures or deploys the password across machines, unattended access on Wayland in mainline builds, and independent hands-on confirmation of unattended connections working.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept
